description:
This stylish two bedroom apartment located within the Armidale Place development is sure to attract strong interest.  Located off Cheltenham Road in Montpelier with excellent transport links and within easy reach of the City Centre, the local amenities of Picton Street and the ever popular Gloucester Road, the property is perfectly placed. 

Internally the apartment consists of an entrance hall with a utility cupboard, two double bedrooms, a lounge/diner, a modern family bathroom and a modern fitted kitchen which includes integrated appliances. 

The property also benefits from an allocated off street parking space in a secure underground car park. 

The monthly rental for this property includes water rates for the duration of the tenancy. 

Further benefits include a secure bike store, gas central heating and double glazing. Viewings are highly recommended.
